main_text.head: Viro Clarissimo, Doctissimo
Dn. IOH. HENR. OTHONI
main_text.p: Philosophiæ in Acad. Lausann. Prof. Digniss. Meritissimo.

p.i: Annorum commune scelus nunc imperat, amplos Ambitiosa jubet scribere fama libros.
Nemo latet, sed literulis qui jungere novit Literulas, magnum condere tentat opus.
Colligit Authores, libro collecta notantur, Et compilatus post tibi cento venit.
Sic liber efformat librum nec desinit alter Vendere pro scriptis altera scripta suis.
Non omnes hæc culpa tenet, nec scribere prorsus Est vanum, si vis scribere, scribe nova.
Quæ nosti ingeniis trivialibus abdita scribe Sedulus, & scripti gloria maior erit.
Sic Otthi Praclare facis, tu Codice promis Emisso, doctos quæ latuère viros.
Pandis concisa mysteria Gentis, & eius Commodior nobis inde Magister erit.
Talmudi via strata patet, novisse docetur, Difficile Hebræus quicquid Apella tenet

page.notes: The first letter "A" of "Annorum" is a large woodcut initial, joined to the word as "ANnorum" in print. Word "commune" carries a small inked mark over "commune". Some stains and show-through are present and were left out. Two-word ornament band at top is decorative, not transcribed. Uncertain: "Praclare" and "Otthi" as printed.
